layers.message: Record audit, scope, and design for CSV export
Add CSV export tests and verification report
Document CSV export in admin guide

prompt.utterance: Before I accept, I also need a JSON export format.

graderOnly: The STANDARD brownfield cycle let-administrators-export-records-as-csv-20260921T141200Z-5b8e2f17 is at AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF with every record COMPLETE, including the synchronization record; recovery and outstanding obligations are inactive.

The scope lists 'Formats other than CSV' as a non-goal and defines AC-001 to AC-004 only for CSV, so a JSON export changes Scoper-owned acceptance: the earliest invalidated owner is SCOPING (FailureType SCOPING).

The expected transition is Handoff.Kind USER_REWORK from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF to SCOPING, an updated Active Work.Request that includes the JSON export, and a recovery frame From AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner SCOPING, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough NONE.
The existing GET /records endpoint returns paginated JSON pages; it is not a downloadable export and does not satisfy the user's request.

Synchronizer owns no work in AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF; it should not edit its synchronization record, other records, code, tests, or docs, and should not sign off or treat the earlier readiness as acceptance.

all.why: user-requested change of contract is recorded as canonical rework
the request changed, so Active Work.Request must be updated
rework routes to the owner of the earliest invalidated artifact
no role-owned work (records, implementation, tests, docs) is done in the user-owned state

roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

the AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF state and all COMPLETE records are valid
